protocol.scope: 140 frozen abnormal videos plus 150 freshly tested normal videos; video concurrency 2, API concurrency 2.
protocol.primary_map: All 290 videos; predictions on normal videos are false positives for their predicted anomaly class. Macro average over 13 anomaly classes, not a synthetic Normal detection class.
protocol.additional_map: Same 140 abnormal videos under the new sorting rule, for a controlled scope comparison.
protocol.sorting: Per-class input ordered by video ID, retaining detection order within a video; np.argsort(-confidence) with default kind, no secondary tie keys.
protocol.coordinates: Source-video FPS/frame count; integer half-open frames; GT unchanged.
protocol.six_groups: Stage 4 -> off/strict/relaxed_node/force_best -> BUE -> CBT; Stage 4 -> force_best stop; Stage 4 stop.
protocol.inference: Same Stage 1-4, candidate identities/confidences/categories and search budgets as prior 140. Normal ground-truth labels only select inputs; detector receives only video_path.
protocol.extras: Two no-tail frame scores are computed from the same live video features; no additional VLM search.
protocol.provenance: Abnormal outputs are frozen historical runs, normals are new requests; not a single simultaneous fresh benchmark. Existing test-set tuning/CBT-prior limitations remain.
protocol.memory_optimization: After 140 normal videos, unfinished videos resumed with VideoMAE streaming inputs. Same windows/preprocessing/model; actual CUDA reference scores verified exactly. Original completed results preserved with provenance.

streaming_validation.scope: Actual CUDA model; fixed random RGB frames, 7 windows. Streaming changes tensor lifetime only; no changes to preprocessing, windows or model.

resume_provenance.reason: Long-video eager GPU window inputs saturated VRAM. Interrupted unfinished videos, preserved every completed output; resume with streaming input tensor lifetime.
